scripts.dev:api: uv run --project services/api uvicorn helvetic_lens.main:app --app-dir services/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:shell && npm run check:resources && npm run check:reports && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:shell && npm run check:resources && npm run check:reports && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.check:reports: node --test scripts/report-dates.test.mjs scripts/topic-history.test.mjs scripts/topic-preview.test.mjs scripts/digest-coverage.test.mjs scripts/inbox-navigation.test.mjs scripts/registry-filters.test.mjs scripts/topic-tab-draft.test.mjs
scripts.test:ai-triage: uv run --cache-dir services/api/.uv-cache --project services/api python scripts/check_ai_triage_regression.py
scripts.test:ai-triage:full: uv run --cache-dir services/api/.uv-cache --project services/api python scripts/check_ai_triage_regression.py --full
scripts.test:ai-triage:review-template: uv run --cache-dir services/api/.uv-cache --project services/api python scripts/check_ai_triage_usability.py
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api
